snippet_primary: "At first, I ignored the fees. It was just cents, right? But by the time I was actually making steady sales, I realized the math didn't add up. Listing fees, transaction fees, ad pushes I never asked for—it felt like Etsy was nickeling and diming me until I was running in circles. One month, I sold about $400 worth of products. After fees and shipping, I barely saw $150. That was the month I stopped calling Etsy my 'business' and started calling it my 'hobby tax.'"
